atomic_facts.fact: Jordan Belfort's full legal name is Jordan Ross Belfort.
Jordan Belfort's date of birth is 1962-07-09.
Jordan Belfort is a former stockbroker.
Jordan Belfort published the memoir The Wolf of Wall Street.
Jordan Belfort pleaded guilty to securities fraud and money laundering in 1999.
Jordan Belfort served 22 months of a four-year prison sentence.
Jordan Belfort's felony conviction remains on his record as of 2026-10-01 (i.e., has not been pardoned or vacated).
